skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of psychology in the workplace, including the formation of skills and attitudes in labor activities.
Analyze and interpret organizational behavior and dynamics within the workplace.
Understand and apply leadership theories and practices in managing teams and groups.
Develop effective communication skills for managing and leading teams.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address issues in the workplace.
Understand and apply research methods in the field of labor psychology.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems in the workplace.
Understand and manage group dynamics and social psychology in the workplace.
Develop self-management skills to enhance personal and professional growth.
Work effectively in teams and manage group activities.
